description: Dynamic values (runic.json "dynamicValues": true, docs/design/M6-DYNAMIC-VALUES.md): untyped JavaScript compiles without types: an array of objects of two shapes, an object of runtime keys, an empty object counting by kind (`counts[k] = (counts[k] || 0) + 1`), a value that is a number or a string, `??` and `||` on dynamic values, Object.keys, filter and map on a dynamic array, a dynamic class value unboxed to a string and a keyed each over dynamic items. Adding and removing items, switching the runtime key and the value's type
